note: Source of truth for this project's shared-methods pack. Edit here, then run `python3 scripts/shared_methods.py render --write`. Replace the example rule; keep the shape.

rules.title: Write JSON files only through the project's atomic writer
applies_when: writing or rewriting a JSON state, cache or manifest file
rules.body: Call the owner's writer so a run killed mid-write leaves the previous file intact. Do not write a tmp-and-rename yourself.
